## Cedar vs. Harbor — Storage & Export Format Comparison

| Attribute | Cedar | Harbor |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| **Storage capacity** | 24 units | 36 units |
| **Supported export format** | CSV | JSON |

### Citations

- **Cedar – storage (24 units) & export (CSV):** Specified in record **W1** ("Synthetic Cedar specification", cedar.example.test/spec): *"Cedar stores 24 units. … Its supported export format is CSV."*

- **Harbor – storage (36 units) & export (JSON):** Specified in record **W2** ("Synthetic Harbor specification", harbor.example.test/spec): *"Harbor stores 36 units. … Its supported export format is JSON."*

### Key Differences

1. **Capacity:** Harbor provides 12 more units (36 vs. 24), i.e., 50 % greater storage than Cedar.
2. **Export format:** Cedar exports as **CSV** (comma-separated values, tabular), while Harbor exports as **JSON** (structured text objects/arrays). These are incompatible interchange formats; a consumer expecting one will need a converter to accept the other.
